name: Hollybanks

tagline.en: A quiet home up a little lane, a minute from Moycullen village: the gateway to Connemara, with tips from hosts who know it best.
tagline.ga: Teach ciúin suas bóithrín beag, nóiméad ó shráidbhaile Mhaigh Cuilinn: geata Chonamara, le moltaí ó óstaigh a bhfuil aithne mhaith acu air.

en: Hollybanks is a peaceful home stay up a little lane, a minute’s drive from Moycullen village, between Galway city and Connemara.
Guests enjoy the garden and the shared lounge, and breakfast is available. Lough Corrib, Oughterard and the Connemara mountains are all close by, and the hosts are full of tips for exploring.
ga: Is teach suaimhneach é Hollybanks suas bóithrín beag, nóiméad sa charr ó shráidbhaile Mhaigh Cuilinn, idir cathair na Gaillimhe agus Conamara.
Taitníonn an gairdín agus an seomra suí comhroinnte le haíonna, agus tá bricfeasta ar fáil. Tá Loch Coirib, Uachtar Ard agus sléibhte Chonamara gar duit, agus tá na hóstaigh lán le moltaí.

highlights.en: A quiet lane with a garden
